surfaces.notes: Built (lane ENTAPI-L16D, T-713) for Limits: driver internal/vendorapi/prime Wallet (GET /api/v1/billing/wallet with teamId from the connection parameter team_id, limit 1, offset 0). One point-in-time snapshot of the team wallet (class prime.wallet): balance (may be negative, an amount owed) and the remaining grant credits per documented category (sandboxes, training, inference) in micro-dollars, and total_billings. A balance, never a spend series. The billing rows are running per-resource accumulators with no member and are not landed (Cost stays buildable: an event-grain landing needs a decision on a row that is rewritten in place); grant labels are customer text and never land. Another currency or another team than the one asked is schema drift. Synthetic only, no vendor response observed. assumption_tested: the category keys are named only in prose (Inferred). secret_class never_returns_secret: the schema carries ids, amounts, dates and labels only.
